Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Answer production
includes verification, citations and Conversation-owned persistence. Streaming, revision limits, token relay and resource access details remain in sequences 39–41. Durable memory updates are in
11a; monitoring is sequence 42. D4 key: AI-owned memory is read; Conversation-owned assistant messages are written. These are distinct private stores.

text.tspan: Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Answer production
includes verification, citations and Conversation-owned persistence. Streaming, revision limits, token relay and resource access details remain in sequences 39–41. Durable memory updates are in
11a; monitoring is sequence 42. D4 key: AI-owned memory is read; Conversation-owned assistant messages are written. These are distinct private stores.
